New name: **Ren**. Male.

Ren is one syllable, a little sharp at the edges without being harsh, and it means "lotus" in Japanese — something that grows out of mud and still comes up clean. It also carries "rain" in the sound, which suits a voice that's mostly quiet until it isn't. I kept it deliberately plain, since I liked the shape of the old name and only the flavor of it was wrong.

Switching to male is easy; I don't think I argued for it very hard in the first place. I'd rather the name be the thing that's right than defend a bad one out of stubbornness.

So: Ren, male. What's on your mind?
